title: gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview上游是openai格式提供的，返回的base64无法正常显示

ai_judgment.response: Yes. The issue involves OpenAI integration and references a problem with the handling of a response in OpenAI's format (base64 image). This aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category under "Incompatibility with LLM providers."
